cross_verification.note_en: Europass (europass.europa.eu), the EU's official CV-building platform, recommends as a finishing-touch tip to 'add a professional photograph of yourself' but does not publish a technical size/background/head-height specification anywhere on the official domain located in this pass — a CV photo in Europe is a country-varying convention (mandatory in some countries, discouraged/rejected in others for anti-discrimination reasons) rather than a single legally mandated document photo. No official EU-level numeric spec exists to verify against the DB's 3.5×4.5cm / solid-color figures, so all technical fields are left unverified.
